manifest.name: Page watch
manifest.description: Watches web pages you list and pushes a link when their text changes, or when they start to contain a phrase you choose.
manifest.author: Ferry

settings.label: Pages to watch, one per line
settings.help: Each must start with http:// or https://. Separate several with spaces, commas or new lines.

settings.label: Only push when the page newly contains
settings.help: Optional, like "in stock" or "tickets on sale". Leave empty to push on any change. Not case-sensitive.
